demo_preview.label: Playable web development preview
demo_preview.note: Web is a development preview target only, not a promised store platform. This build is connect4 commit c3e8dff: the hub-and-picker navigation, the one-screen first run, the pause menu with resign, a match that is saved after every move, and the 126-lesson course.

methodology.summary: Each acceptance criterion is binary: done only when verified by a file, git history, GitHub issue/API output, or a tool command. Milestone percent is completed criteria divided by total criteria. Overall percent is the sum of milestone weight multiplied by completed criteria divided by total criteria.
methodology.arithmetic: Governance and evidence base: 8 * 4/4 = 8.0000; Development environment and target build capability: 12 * 4/5 = 9.6000; Art direction and asset pipeline: 15 * 10/17 = 8.8235; Playable Flutter game implementation: 45 * 28/28 = 45.0000; Offline, privacy, accessibility, and monetization promises: 10 * 17/19 = 8.9474; QA, release, and store readiness: 5 * 27/31 = 4.3548; Public status dashboard: 5 * 5/5 = 5.0000; total = 89.7257 of 100

lib/data/local_store.dart uses shared_preferences and persists palette choice, reduce-motion preference, describe-board preference, local stats, puzzle solved days, and lesson completion.

Lessons were improved in a68bf38: 7 of 8 passive readings now ask for a move; new mostLines, killerSquare, and onlyMove kinds use positions mined by tool/find_shapes.dart and tool/find_lessons.dart, not authored by eye.

The course is 126 lessons (22 hand-written, 104 mined by tool/build_course.dart) graded into four steps. test/lessons_test.dart re-derives every claim each lesson makes from the rules engine, so no lesson can assert something the game does not do; 297 tests pass at ef67381.

Multi-move lessons exist: LessonKind.forcedLine teaches a two-move plan where the opponent's only block builds the winning line. Each mined sequence is verified - the first move makes exactly one threat, every alternative reply loses on the spot, and the finish is the unique winning column.

Gamification layer in lib/game/progress.dart: Elo-style rating against a fixed opponent ladder, named levels, win streaks, and 16 achievements, shown on the result panel and a "Your play" screen. test/progress_test.dart pins that no badge can be earned by losing and that finishing a lesson never moves the rating.

A lost match names the lesson that drills the mistake it turned on (lib/game/lesson_suggestion.dart), shown only when the turning point was the player's own move and never in pass-and-play. test/practise_card_test.dart plays a real seeded match to a loss and asserts the card appears.

The app has a front door: lib/ui/home_screen.dart is a hub that leads with Continue or Play, then the daily puzzle, lessons, record, and How to play; lib/ui/play_screen.dart is the opponent picker behind it. Covered by test/form_factor_test.dart and test/smoke_test.dart at c3e8dff.

An unfinished match survives leaving the screen and the app: lib/data/local_store.dart SavedMatch is written after every move and replayed on resume, verified by 10 tests in test/saved_match_test.dart.
A pause menu with resume, restart, resign, and quit exists; resigning is the only action that asks, because it is the only destructive one. 8 tests in test/nav_guard_test.dart.

A new player gets one skippable welcome screen that pre-answers the piece-contrast question from the platform high-contrast flag and is never shown again; 11 tests in test/welcome_test.dart, including that the store-less degraded mode shows no greeting at all.

milestones.name: Offline, privacy, accessibility, and monetization promises

acceptance_criteria.evidence: AGENTS.md documents the fixed free-core/no-ads/no-tracking/offline-first monetization contract.
The committed app is an offline local game with no backend/account/tracking integration recorded; lib/main.dart states offline-first: no backend, account, ads, or tracking.
lib/ui/settings_screen.dart states the game runs entirely on-device with no account and no advertising.
Two accessible palettes, Warm and High contrast, are user-selectable and persisted through lib/data/local_store.dart.
The reduce-motion preference is additive only: it ORs with the platform disableAnimations flag, so user preference can add restraint but never remove the platform setting.
LinefallPalette.byName falls back to the default for unknown or corrupt stored values; this is covered by a test.
Stats are local counts only: per-opponent win/loss/draw records, no timestamps, no move logs, nothing identifying; pass-and-play is deliberately not recorded.
The daily puzzle has no countdown, no streak, no penalty for a wrong guess, and the correct answer still works after a wrong one; only solved days are stored and the list is bounded to 400 entries.
The daily puzzle is fully playable with no store at all, covered by a test, and is free with no gate or purchase prompt.
The 20 strategy lessons have no score, no streak, no timer, and a wrong answer leaves the position untouched so it can be retried immediately.
Only completed lessons are stored as a bookmark; corrupt stored lesson entries are skipped rather than crashing, and lessons work with no store at all. Both behaviours are covered by tests.
A test asserts that no lesson screen contains unlock, upgrade, buy, or premium, and another asserts the home-screen entry says Twenty short lessons. All free.

Optional theme backgrounds obey accessibility constraints by test: every image sits under a palette scrim of at least 0.55, high-contrast suppresses backgrounds entirely, images are excluded from semantics, and an unknown stored id falls back to none.

Production privacy disclosure artifact exists: lib/ui/privacy_screen.dart is generated from LocalStore.disclosure, docs/PRIVACY.md records store privacy answers, and test/privacy_test.dart verifies disclosure coverage, no networking markers/dependencies, and no Android INTERNET permission.
Release APK builds and aapt2 dump permissions shows no INTERNET permission.
Player identity is carried by mark and colour; b845574 replaced colour-only player labels and test/identity_test.dart prevents regression.

premium_strategy_pack has an honest purchase surface in lib/data/entitlements.dart and lib/ui/premium_screen.dart, but no real store backend is wired up. Default backend is unavailable, buy is disabled as Not on sale yet, and real sale requires owner-held store product IDs.
Store forms have not been submitted and no developer account exists, so store privacy submission/readiness is not done.

The paid promise now has content behind it and no longer overstates: the strategy pack adds the 84 mined practice positions, and the unimplemented "deeper post-match analysis" claim was removed from the purchase screen. Every idea in the course stays free - all hand-written lessons and the whole first step, 42 lessons, well above the 20-lesson floor in AGENTS.md section 8. test/lesson_gating_test.dart pins that every LessonKind and every tier has a free lesson.

test/insight_test.dart adds 7 tests that replay real mined games and re-derive every exact Move That Mattered claim with Solver directly rather than trusting the insight engine report.

Theme-background tests enforce scrim strength, high-contrast suppression, semantic exclusion, and fallback to none for unknown stored ids.
test/assets_test.dart asserts every declared portrait is genuinely in the asset bundle, is RGBA, and is 256x256; a pubspec.yaml line alone would not catch a missing file.

test/lessons_test.dart re-derives every authored lesson claim from the rules engine, including the newer mined lesson kinds.

recent_changes.summary: Rating, named levels, win streaks and 16 achievements, with a "Your play" screen. The course stays unscored: practising can never farm a level.
A lost match now names the lesson that drills the mistake it turned on. Also fixed a real layout bug the taller result panel exposed: the stacked layout overflowed instead of scrolling.
Made the paid promise true: the strategy pack adds the mined practice positions, the unimplemented analysis claim is gone, and every idea in the course stays free.
A 126-row course gets a next step - one "Start here"/"Carry on" card - and a locked lesson can no longer be walked into from the end of the previous one.
LEARNING.md L-053 to L-059, including the lesson/play boundary decision: the two stay separate systems joined by one after-the-fact loop.

Closed the 8 blockers a review found in the new navigation. The worst: the pause menu is reachable while the opponent is thinking, so resigning there recorded a win and the reply in flight then played into a finished match. Actions that end a match now bump a generation token every await rechecks.

LEARNING.md L-066 to L-070: the opponent's thinking window is a real place; "during a match" means every screen the match can reach; an irreversible write must disable the control that repeats it; one save slot makes replacement a decision; a test that races a real interaction is not a test.
